snippet.title: Ironwing Valiant Feature Update - 02-12-2026
snippet.description:
Hello everyone, apologies for the long absence from Youtube. We were busy adding many new features to the game and making changes from feedback received in the Playtest! Below I will list the new additions we have made to the game.

- Targeting range values have been added per component - true Sniper builds can now be made

- Torso and lower body have been separated for animations 

- Damage drop off for kinetic weapons have been
implemented

- Optimal range stat implemented - All weapons have ranges where they are most accurate or have accuracy penalty

- Temporary stats implemented - Example: LAA receive extra lock on range when in Flight Mode AB

- Shooting down missiles is now easier, gun convergence automatically handled.
